description: The plot illustrates the similarity across different layers, comparing four distinct representations denoted by 'en&en', 'en&es', 'en&el', and 'en&bn'. The x-axis is labeled 'Layer', with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 22, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled 'Similarity', also on a linear scale, spanning from 0.00 to 0.45 with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. The 'en&en' line, colored red, starts at approximately 0.05 at layer 0, peaks at around 0.27 at layer 6, then declines to about 0.08 at layer 20 before rising sharply to 0.45 at layer 22. The 'en&es' line, in blue, begins at roughly 0.05 at layer 0, reaches a peak of approximately 0.23 at layer 6, decreases to around 0.08 at layer 20, and then increases to about 0.38 at layer 22. The 'en&el' line, shown in green, starts at about 0.03 at layer 0, peaks at around 0.15 at layer 6, drops to approximately 0.03 at layer 20, and then rises to about 0.32 at layer 22. The 'en&bn' line, in purple, begins at roughly 0.03 at layer 0, reaches a peak of approximately 0.14 at layer 6, decreases to around 0.03 at layer 20, and then increases to about 0.31 at layer 22.
